body.condition: The collection \(\{E_{\ell j a,n}:1\le\ell\le L, j\in J,1\le a\le n_{\ell j}\}\) is mutually independent for every \(n\).

novel.justification: Outcome-independent splitting of independent complete blocks into predeclared pair--role samples realizes this condition while preserving each role's marginal event probability.
